title: How to get a second phone number on your iPhone
summary: Four ways to get a second phone number on an iPhone, including eSIM and app-based options. Plus, find out the best second number apps for iOS compared.
body_markdown:
Getting a second phone number for your iPhone is a great way to separate business and personal calls. You don’t need a new phone to get an[alternate phone number](https://www.quo.com/blog/alternate-phone-number/) .


You can add a second phone number to an iPhone in two ways. The first option is to use a virtual phone number app. Download a second-number app, pick a number, and start calling and texting from inside the app. This option takes a few minutes and needs no SIM. The second option is to get an eSIM for your iPhone. Activate a second line as an eSIM in your phone’s settings.


The biggest difference between these two options is setup time and whether you can share numbers. Virtual phone numbers are easier to set up and can be shared easily with a team. eSIMs take longer to set up and you can’t share an eSIM number with your team. However, eSIM numbers can be used just like a regular mobile number, including for verification codes. This guide will help you narrow down the choices for the best app that lets you[get a second phone number](https://www.quo.com/blog/get-second-phone-number/) on your iPhone for your business. Read on to learn about pricing, key features of the best apps, and more.

##


How to get a second phone number on your iPhone with a virtual phone app


Follow these steps to get a second phone number with a virtual phone app:


1. Choose your virtual phone provider and create an account with them.
2. During signup, choose your city or area code in the US to select your preferred phone number.
3. Once the signup process is complete, you’re all set to use your new second virtual phone number.


If you want to port an existing number, virtual phone apps make number[porting](https://www.quo.com/porting) easy.


##


How to get a second phone number on your iPhone with an eSIM


If you contacted your carrier for an eSIM after you setup your iPhone, and they digitally sent you an eSIM through eSIM Carrier Activation, follow these steps:


1. When the notification, Carrier Cellular Plan Ready to Be Installed, appears on the screen, tap it.
2. In the Settings app, tap Carrier Cellular Plan Ready to Be Installed.
3. Tap Continue at the bottom of the screen.
4. Make a call on your iPhone to check its cellular connectivity. If you can’t make a call, contact your carrier.
5. If the plan you activated replaces the plan on your physical SIM, remove your physical SIM, and restart your iPhone.


Apple lets you install eSIMs using multiple different methods. Check out[Apple Support](https://support.apple.com/en-us/118669) to understand all the different ways to install eSIMs in your iPhone.

2. **Separate personal and business calls to retain privacy.** Using a second phone number app for iPhone ensures you can always differentiate whether a call is intended for work because you’ll see a different call screen.
3. **Shared inbox to split responsibility for incoming tasks.** A shared inbox lets teammates work together on client communications. For example, teams using Quo can collaborate on incoming calls and texts via a single inbox.
4. **Call routing to help customers get to the right place.** Choose a second phone number app that helps[route calls](https://www.quo.com/product/call-routing) efficiently. It should be able to manage incoming calls based on your team’s preferences, with ring order, IVR, and backup call routing features.

**FAQs**


****What is a second phone number app?****


A second phone number app allows you to manage two numbers on the same device. This means you don’t have to give out your personal number to customers, purchase a business landline, or purchase a separate SIM card.


****Does a second number app use my iPhone’s minutes or data?****


Most second number apps can use WiFi. They won’t use any minutes you may have purchased. However, if you aren’t connected to a WiFi network, they can use your iPhone’s data roaming to make calls.


****How can I get a second phone number app for iPhone?****


Choose one of the second number apps we’ve highlighted in this article. Then, download their iOS app from the App Store on your device and start using it.


****How do I get a free second number on my iPhone?****


You can get a free second phone number with online providers like[Google Voice](https://www.quo.com/blog/google-voice-alternatives/) . But for businesses, a paid option makes more sense. Without it, you won’t have toll-free numbers, the ability to set business hours, or a dedicated address book to manage your contacts.


****Can you have two phone numbers on one iPhone?****


Yes, you can have two phone numbers on one iPhone with a second phone number app or a dual SIM phone. With virtual phone providers like Quo, you can have as many numbers as you want. Access your numbers on your iPhone and on any device you may choose to use.


****Can I just use two SIMs on my iPhone?****


Some iPhone models, including iPhone 13 and later, are dual SIM phones, which means that they allow you to use[two active eSIMs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/109317) at the same time. The problem with using two SIMs on your phone is you can’t share your second number with a team. Calls and texts that come in to your second SIM will be siloed from them, which creates more work to share context later.


****What are the benefits of using a second phone number on my iPhone?****


Using a second number on your iPhone helps you keep work and personal conversations separate. With Quo, you can get a dedicated business number that lives in its own app, so you don’t have to mix messages or share your personal number. That way, you can handle all your calls, texts, and voicemails from one place without switching devices.


****Is it possible to have two numbers with a SIM and an eSIM?****


Yes, as long as your iPhone supports both. One number can be tied to your physical SIM, and the other can run on your eSIM. Both your phone numbers can make and receive voice and FaceTime calls and send and receive messages using iMessage, SMS, and MMS.


If you’d rather avoid dealing with SIM settings, virtual phone apps offer a simpler option. You can add a second number instantly — no carrier changes or SIM swaps needed.


**Can I use a second number app for WhatsApp, Telegram, or Uber verification?**


No, most messaging, banking, and ride-hailing services require a carrier-provided mobile number for verification.
